# Continu

> Continu is an enterprise AI-powered learning management platform that enables organizations to deliver personalized training across customer, partner, and employee audiences.

Continu provides an integrated suite of LMS solutions with AI-driven automation, content discovery, and analytics capabilities. The platform serves diverse use cases from compliance and onboarding to revenue-generating external training, trusted by leading companies like Instacart, GoPro, and Vivid Seats.

## Key Topics

- Eddy AI Agent
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Employee Training
- Customer Training
- Partner Training
- Compliance Training
- Employee Onboarding
- Training Automation
- Personalized Learning
- Learning Analytics
- Smart Segmentation
- Content Authoring
- Sales Training
- Revenue Generation
- Learning Paths

## Core Platform

- [Continu | The Enterprise Enablement Platform](https://www.continu.com): Continu AI enablement platform for customer, partner, and employee learning
- [Eddy | The Conversational AI Agent Built for the Flow of Work](https://www.continu.com/ai-learning-agent): Eddy AI agent delivers trusted answers in Slack, Teams, and Google Drive

## Training Solutions by Audience

- [Internal Training LMS | Turn Internal Training into Higher ROI](https://www.continu.com/internal-training): AI-powered LMS for internal staff training, onboarding, and compliance
- [External Training LMS | Turn External Training into Revenue](https://www.continu.com/external-training): AI-powered LMS for external training, customer and partner enablement
- [Customer Training Software | Drive Revenue and Retention](https://www.continu.com/solutions/customer-training): Customer training platform for revenue growth and product adoption
- [Partner Training LMS | Supercharge Partner Sales and Loyalty](https://www.continu.com/solutions/partner-training): Partner training LMS for sales enablement and partner loyalty
- [Employee Training LMS | Upskill Teams and Boost Productivity](https://www.continu.com/solutions/employee-training): Employee training LMS for skills development and productivity gains

## Specialized Training Programs

- [Compliance Training LMS | Ensure 100% Compliance Rates](https://www.continu.com/solutions/compliance-training): Compliance training LMS with audit-ready tracking and automation
- [Employee Onboarding LMS | Get New Hires Up to Speed Quickly](https://www.continu.com/solutions/employee-onboarding): Employee onboarding LMS with automation and personalized learning paths
- [Sales Training LMS | Boost Performance and Close More Deals](https://www.continu.com/solutions/sales-training): Sales training LMS for enablement, coaching, and performance tracking

## Platform Features

- [AI LMS | Ditch the Busy Work with AI and Automations](https://www.continu.com/features/ai): Continu AI-driven automation for content recommendations and workflows
- [Explore | Ultimate Hub for Personalized Learning Discovery](https://www.continu.com/features/explore): AI-powered learning discovery hub with personalized recommendations
- [Smart Segmentation | Create Unique, Flexible Audiences](https://www.continu.com/features/smart-segmentation): Smart Segmentation for targeted content delivery and personalization
- [eLearning Authoring Tool | Streamline Content Creation](https://www.continu.com/features/content-authoring): AI-powered content authoring tool for course creation and personalization
- [Assignments | LMS Automation Software: Save Time and Streamline Training](https://www.continu.com/features/assignments): Assignment automation for streamlined training delivery and onboarding
- [Continu Insights | AI-Powered Business Intelligence for Learning Analytics](https://www.continu.com/features/insights): Continu Insights BI tool for learning analytics and training ROI tracking

## Revenue & Integration Features

- [E-commerce LMS | Turn Training into a Revenue Generator](https://www.continu.com/features/ecommerce): E-commerce LMS with Stripe integration for course monetization
- [Extend | Seamless Multi-Branding to Elevate External Training](https://www.continu.com/features/extend): Multi-branded external training platform with smart segmentation
